prompts.atlas: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas, transparent background. Create exactly twelve isolated premium 3D-rendered game objects arranged in an exact 4 columns by 3 rows uniform grid, one object centered in each cell, generous transparent gutters, absolutely no text or cell borders. Each object fills 70% of its cell. Read left to right, top to bottom: row 1: a lively curled emerald botanical leaf with a clear stem and detailed branching veins; a glossy clear turquoise water droplet with caustics; a rich red apple with green leaf and stem; a full coral-pink rose blossom with layered silky petals. Row 2: a brilliant faceted violet diamond with realistic refractive edges; a round dark teal cartoon garden bomb with brass collar and tiny glowing wick; a bundle of three scarlet dynamite sticks tied with rope, no lettering; a large brass spherical mega bomb with rose-gold seams and glowing wick. Row 3: an iridescent rainbow prism orb with colorful facets; a charming small cream and mint delivery rover with four tires and flower crates, seen top-down for racing; an appealing cream ceramic gardening robot with amber glass eyes, a leafy sprout and little articulated feet, three-quarter front view; a shiny thick gold coin embossed with a leaf. Cohesive high quality animated family-adventure game rendering, tactile materials, rich saturated natural color, warm key light upper left, rounded pleasing silhouettes. Botanical objects must be identifiable as real leaves/rose/apple and diamond, with depth and life, not flat geometric icons. Orthographic camera, no backdrop, no ground plane or background shadow, actual alpha transparency. Perfectly aligned 4x3 sprite sheet for equal-cell extraction.
prompts.world: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait mobile game world backdrop, no UI or lettering. A premium animated 3D miniature botanical moon settlement, very close view of a welcoming cream ceramic greenhouse with arched glass windows and brass trim, lush dimensional green leaves, full coral roses and apple trees, terraced farm beds with rich soil and crops, a winding pale stone path curving toward a little delivery circuit around the garden, one charming small cream gardening robot tending sprouts. Morning sunlight, rich emerald foliage, tactile soil, flowers that have layered petals, turquoise water, peach and golden highlights. Small floating island in the sky with distant soft planets and pale teal clouds, light airy whimsical sci-fi farm world. Camera is near orthographic elevated three-quarter view. Beautiful production game environment, crisp carefully modeled surfaces, full bleed portrait composition, top 15% softly open sky for title overlay, lower 15% path with room for buttons. No symbols, no panels, no text, no collage. Original art direction independent of existing commercial games.
